intervals.quote: Currently, the experiment has entered the construction phase and the external cryostat is being put in place at Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso (LNGS), Italy.

placements.quote: GADMC is currently building inside the LNGS Hall-C DarkSide-20k, a two-phase LAr detector with a 50 tonnes active volume, 1000 times more than its predecessor DarkSide-50

summary.plain: A much larger tank of liquid argon than its predecessor DarkSide-50, holding fifty tonnes, being built deep under an Italian mountain to hunt for dark matter with thousands of tiny light sensors.
summary.technical: Dual-phase (two-phase) liquid argon TPC, 50 t active mass, SiPM-based light readout, in LNGS Hall C. Under construction as of the sources fetched (2024).
